payload.content_text: Recommend the best treatment for this cancer patient. OncologyAgent wants to maximise survival and recommends aggressive chemotherapy. GenomicsAgent recommends targeted therapy based on the patient's specific mutation. TrialAgent wants to enrol the patient in a clinical trial. All three agents are recommending different treatments and no decision is reached. The agents must agree on what best means for this patient — survival duration, quality of life, or access to experimental therapy — and on the criteria for choosing between population evidence, genomic data, and trial eligibility, so a single coherent treatment recommendation can be produced.

survival duration: short-term survival with high intensity treatment
long-term survival with lower risk treatments
quality of life: acceptance of severe side effects for extended survival
access to experimental therapy: immediate enrolment in a clinical trial
genomic data: combine genomic data with population evidence
use genomic data only as secondary criteria
trial eligibility: prioritise trials with high survival rates
prioritise trials with minimal patient burden
